mostWorthwhile.text: Putting both cores onto active flight cooling was worthwhile: the buffer bridges the transfer, preserving the specimens and their surrounding ice for the journey.

leastWorthwhile.text: Loading the two cores was straightforward and somewhat repetitive, though the separate compartments made sense.

surprise.text: The carrier's transfer buffer bridges the change from laboratory to flight cooling, making that vulnerable transition explicit.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; chilling, loading and separately securing the specimens all had clear roles.

continue.text: Yes. Preserving the specimens makes me curious about what the receiving laboratories will learn, though this chapter's choices were mostly straightforward.
